# `billing_run_account`

Area: **worker** ([all tables](README.md))

The outcome of one billing account in one billing run (ours): ok, failed (with the error) or blocked (waiting for an earlier failed run of that account).

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The billing run (one date). |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | A member account of the run: opened before 00:00 of the run date (BILLING_TZ). |
| `status` | `billing_run_account_status` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | ok, failed or blocked. |
| `error` | `text` | yes |  | The BillingError of a failed account; set iff failed. |
| `waits_for_run_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The earlier failed run a blocked account waits for; set iff blocked. |
| `attempts` | `integer` | no | `1` | How many times this account was processed in this run. |
| `finished_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the outcome was recorded (injected clock). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | When the row was inserted: the database's now(), not the injected clock. Never used for billing decisions. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Last change: the database's now(), maintained by the set_updated_at trigger. |

| `billing_run_account_attempts_positive` | check | `CHECK ((attempts >= 1))` |

| `billing_run_account_waits_for_another_run` | check | `CHECK ((waits_for_run_id <> run_id))` |
| `billing_run_account_waits_iff_blocked` | check | `CHECK (((status = 'blocked'::billing_run_account_status) = (waits_for_run_id IS NOT NULL)))` |
